noise_scaling.note: 0.7142857142857143 is the double nearest 5/7; carry the literal

noise_parameters._note: pack data — prefer reading at runtime over hardcoding (Q5.11)

pressure._note_pressure_term_abs_cutoff: Gate operand is the PRESSURE TERM u, not the Barrier noise value. Per Q6.4: if |u| <= 2 the Barrier noise is sampled at the block position and added to u; otherwise the noise is not consumed at all and 0 is used in its place. Gating on |b| (the noise value) instead of |u| is a wrong implementation.

coverage_budget._note: measured on one seed over 4096 chunks; order-of-magnitude guidance, NOT invariants
coverage_budget._formula: chunks >= N / r, where r is events per chunk and N the desired expected exercises

a4_term_four_way_junction.note: never instrumented; no defensible bound from existing data. Treat golden regions as providing ZERO coverage of this path until the next instrumented run measures it.

integer_widths.division: floor (toward -infinity) for every cell index, contraction and snap
integer_widths.prelim_conversion: 32-bit floor of the router value at (4*floordiv(x,4), 0, 4*floordiv(z,4))
integer_widths.pressure_midpoint: 0.5 * double(L_A + L_B) (exact half, not integer division)
integer_widths.lattice_point_y_hazard: open-question: top cell j=170 point at 2048 and bottom cell j=-171 points below -2048 are reduced; reachable only with pack dimension height / sea_level edges

fp_forms.claim: floating-point amendments under Q5.9, Q6.6 (and Q5.6, REVIEW-15 §2)
fp_forms.barrier_products: s12*P12; (s12*s13)*P13; (s12*s23)*P23 -- weight first, then the pressure, left to right; then D + product > 0.0
